summary.text: Jermaine Johnson is a state representative, former professional basketball player and small business owner who has served in the South Carolina House since December 2020. He is the Democratic nominee for governor, running with Sam Skardon. He supports expanding Medicaid, has opposed Republican-backed abortion laws and introduced a resolution calling for a moratorium on data centers.

paragraphs.text: Born in Los Angeles; earned a bachelor's degree from the College of Charleston, a master's from Strayer University and a doctorate in business administration from Northcentral University; played professional basketball from 2009 to 2015.
Took office in the South Carolina House in December 2020 and now represents District 52 (previously Districts 80 and 70). Serves on the House Labor, Commerce and Industry Committee.
His campaign says his accomplishments in office include expanding broadband access, repairing roads and bridges and creating the Lower Richland Tech Academy.
